title: James Ossuary
summary: An ossuary with an inscription that has been proposed as referring to James, the brother of Jesus.
historical_context: Famous because of the inscription and the controversy around provenance and reading.
ancient_near_east_context: The item belongs to the broader imperial, cultic, and urban world of the ancient Near East and the biblical periods reflected in the dataset.
literary_context: Often discussed in relation to the New Testament figure of James.
covenantal_significance: James Ossuary helps anchor biblical claims in historical reality while reminding readers that archaeology supports rather than replaces interpretation.
interpretive_notes: Provenance, authenticity, and inscription interpretation are disputed; BHF treats this as a debated item rather than a settled identification.
Use the item as context for the biblical text, not as a shortcut around it.
